description: Pause a scheduled, compiling, or sending email campaign. Messages already handed off still deliver; nothing more is sent. The pause_reason is always api, and the platform never resumes an api pause by itself: resume with resume_email_campaign. Safe to call repeatedly: an already paused campaign returns its own pause_reason (which may be one the platform set) and any planned resume_at is cancelled. A 409 CONFLICT means the campaign is a draft, awaiting test or approval, ready, or completed. Works even while sending is suspended. Pausing an email in a sequence holds its follow-ups; a paused triggered campaign refuses new recipients.
name: pause_email_campaign
